customer_name: Hainan Airlines (海南航空股份有限公司)
business_problem: Hainan Airlines needed to stop scraping, fake seat holds, and marketing abuse across its digital channels because those attacks were raising costs, destabilizing pricing, and hurting direct-sales conversion.
solution_summary: Hainan Airlines deployed Dingxiang's intelligent risk-control stack to stop bots and abuse across airfare search, seat inventory, and marketing workflows. The core intelligent risk-control platform combines multi-dimensional business data to score traffic and identify risky behavior in real time. Around that core, the airline added an intelligent CAPTCHA service for human-versus-bot verification and a device-fingerprint tool that creates a unique identifier for each device so spoofed clients can be detected even when they rotate accounts or requests. Query, booking, and campaign interactions are evaluated by the risk engine, which can block malicious crawling, false seat holds, and promotional abuse while allowing normal passengers to continue with minimal friction. The deployment stabilizes the airline's pricing system by cutting invalid query traffic and gives operations teams a common fraud-response layer instead of manual review across separate channels.

solution_components.name: Dingxiang intelligent risk-control platform
solution_components.role: Scores traffic and business activity from multiple data dimensions to identify risky airline interactions.

solution_components.name: intelligent CAPTCHA tool
solution_components.role: Performs human-versus-bot verification to block automated abuse in airline workflows.

solution_components.name: device fingerprint tool
solution_components.role: Generates unique device identifiers so spoofed clients and repeated abuse can be detected.

data_flow: Ticket-query, seat-booking, and campaign requests are combined with device signals and other business data, then checked by device fingerprinting, CAPTCHA, and the intelligent risk-control platform. The risk engine decides whether to block or allow the interaction, reducing scraping, fake seat holds, and fraudulent campaign activity before those requests affect pricing or customer experience.
business_outcome: The system reduced abusive traffic and fraudulent activity, stabilized airfare-query operations, and improved legitimate customer experience while saving the airline substantial operating cost.
metrics: more than RMB 5 million in annual losses from ticket-information scraping
more than RMB 10 million in annual marketing losses from abuse
saved several million yuan in operating costs
architecture_clues: The risk engine combines multi-dimensional business data for automated risk judgment.
Human verification and device fingerprinting are separate control layers around the scoring platform.
The deployment targets scraping, fake seat holds, and promotional abuse in airline digital channels.

"Third-party OTA companies held seats maliciously, which sharply reduced conversion and kept the direct-sales rate well below 50%. (original: 第三方OTA公司实占、虚占航班座位，导致销售转化率大幅降低，直销率远低于50%。)"
"Marketing abuse such as coupon farming caused annual losses of more than RMB 10 million. (original: 薅羊毛等营销作弊行为，每年给航司造成1000万以上的营销费用损失。)"
"The intelligent risk-control platform combines multi-dimensional business data to judge risk intelligently. (original: 结合多维度业务数据，智能判断风险。)"

"The Dingxiang intelligent risk-control platform helped Hainan Airlines identify risk precisely, save several million yuan in operating costs, reduce overall flight-query fees by 90%, and improve normal users' query efficiency and experience.
